why.headline: Practise a two-handed push with the ball.

claims.text: Adult goalkeepers use their hands to start attacks. This card practises a two-handed push.
A youth trial measured chest throws after mixed training. The trial used a heavier ball.
In two trials, children trained twice weekly on machines. After 8 weeks, chest press strength rose 11.5 to 16.8%.
In a youth trial, two mixed programs trained twice weekly. After 6 weeks, chest throws went 5.6 to 14.4% further.

keep_up.text: Everyone learns at their own pace. Young people develop at different rates.

map.plain: The muscles at the back of your upper arms

note.text: Adult studies measured these muscles in push-ups, not this pass.

claims.text: In one youth study, mixed training included resistance work. Chest throws were tested with a heavier ball.
In a youth trial, some groups trained with chest presses. Some also used medicine balls.

limits.text: The youth trials tested whole programs, not this football pass. They do not predict your result.
